summary: CSS colors can be written as names, hex codes, rgb(), or hsl(). Sizes use units: px is fixed, rem follows the root font size, and % follows the parent element.
notes: #a33a00 is three hex pairs: a3 red, 3a green, 00 blue. rgb(46, 125, 50) writes the same idea in decimal.
In rgb(29 78 137 / 25%) the value after the slash is alpha (opacity), so the page background shows through.
Use rem for font sizes. If someone sets a larger default font in their browser, rem text grows with it and px text does not.
pitfall: Writing a hex color without the # (color: a33a00;). The browser ignores the whole declaration.
